the expected distortion between a random spike sequence and an optogenetically stimulated spike sequence is a function of the stimulation rate, the stimulation duty cycle, and the filter cutoff frequency.
the distortion of an optogenetically-stimulated neuron is approximately linear in the stimulation rate and that this distortion increases with increasing target generation rate.
the expected distortion is proportional to the inverse of the target sequence generation time and that the expected distortion increases with the variance of the neuron response time.
